reactions: [Hacker News] Motivated by this comment I decided to give it another shot, the tab crashed immediately upon clicking the "fly" button.
[Hacker News] This is a website, not an O'Neill cylinder, and I can't walk around it.

Never did hand code it, even though I gained a lot of the skills and work in gamedev. This makes me feel time is running out to implement it with some of the unique twists I had in mind that become apparent with something
